units.source_text: 信笔乱书，却非常可观，富有趣致。

en.t: Though written in a careless, freehand way, it was remarkably pleasing to look at and full of charm.

units.source_text: 浮舟年方青春，性情本不十分稳重，读了这封长长的情书，对他的爱慕之心越发加深了。

en.t: Ukifune was still young, and by nature not very steady; after reading this long love letter, her affection for him deepened all the more.

units.source_text: 然而想起最初结契的那位薰大将，觉得此人毕竟修养功深，人品优越。

en.t: Yet when she thought of Captain Kaoru, with whom she had first formed a bond, she felt that he was, after all, deeply cultivated and superior in character.

units.source_text: 大约因为这是最初使她经历人事的人，所以她很重视，想道：“我那暧昧之事如果被他闻之，他势必疏远我，此时叫我如何是好？

en.t: Perhaps because he was the first man to make her know such matters, she valued him greatly and thought, "If he hears of this ambiguous affair of mine, he will surely draw away from me; what am I to do now?

units.source_text: 母亲正在焦灼盼望他早日迎我进京，遇到了这意外之变，势必非常伤心。

en.t: My mother is anxiously hoping that he will soon bring me to the capital, and if she meets with this unexpected turn of events, she will surely be terribly grieved.

units.source_text: 而这个专心致志的匂亲王呢，我早就听说他是一个本性非常浮薄的男子，目前虽然如此爱我，日后如何不得而知。

en.t: As for this devoted Prince Niou, I have long heard that he is by nature a very frivolous man; although he loves me so much now, there is no knowing what will happen later.

units.source_text: 即使依旧爱我，把我隐匿在京中，长久地视为他的侧室，叫我怎么对得起我的姐姐呢？

en.t: Even if he continues to love me, hides me away in the capital, and treats me for a long time as his concubine, how could I face my elder sister?

units.source_text: 况且人世之事总不能隐瞒到底。

en.t: Besides, affairs in this world can never be hidden forever.

units.source_text: 例如在二条院那天傍晚，我只因偶然被他撞见，后来虽然躲藏在宇治山中，也终于被他找到。

en.t: For example, that evening at the Nijō residence, he merely happened to catch sight of me, and afterward, though I hid in the mountains of Uji, he found me in the end.

units.source_text: 何况叫我住在京中，无论怎样隐匿，岂有不被薰大将闻知之理？”

en.t: If I am made to live in the capital, then no matter how I am hidden, how could there be any reason that Captain Kaoru would not hear of it?"

units.source_text: 她左思右想了一会，终于悟得：“我自己也有过失。

en.t: After turning it over in her mind for a while, she finally realized, "I myself am also at fault.

units.source_text: 为此而被大将遗弃，实可痛心！”

en.t: If I am abandoned by the Captain because of this, it will truly break my heart!"

units.source_text: 正在对着匂亲王的信胡思乱想之时，薰大将的使者送信来了。

en.t: Just as she was lost in confused thoughts over Prince Niou's letter, Captain Kaoru's messenger arrived with a letter.

units.source_text: 两封信同看，实太难堪。

en.t: To look at the two letters together was truly more than she could bear.

units.source_text: 她便仍然躺在那里阅读匂亲王的长信。

en.t: So she remained lying there and continued reading Prince Niou's long letter.

units.source_text: 侍从对右近使个眼色：“她终于见新弃旧了。”

en.t: Jijū gave Ukon a look, as if to say, "She has finally taken up with the new and cast off the old."

units.source_text: 这句话尽在不言之中。

en.t: Those words were fully conveyed without being spoken.

units.source_text: 侍从说道：“这是当然的呀！

en.t: Jijū said, "It is only natural!

units.source_text: 大将的相貌固然优美无比，但亲王的风度毕竟更加俊俏。

en.t: The Captain's looks are certainly incomparably beautiful, but the Prince's manner is, after all, even more handsome and alluring.

units.source_text: 他放任不拘的时候，神情真娇艳呢！

en.t: When he behaves freely and without restraint, his expression is truly captivating!

units.source_text: 叫我做了小姐，受过了他这等爱怜之后，决不肯呆在这里。

en.t: If I were the young lady, after receiving such affection from him, I would never be willing to stay here.

units.source_text: 总要设法到皇后那里去当个宫女，才能常常看到他。”

en.t: I would somehow find a way to go serve as a lady-in-waiting to the Empress, so that I could see him often."

units.source_text: 右近说：“你这个人也是靠不住的。

en.t: Ukon said, "You are not very dependable either.

units.source_text: 比大将人品更高的人，到哪里去找啊？

en.t: Where could one ever find someone of higher character than the Captain?

units.source_text: 相貌且不谈，他那性情和仪态，多么优越！

en.t: Leaving his looks aside, how excellent his nature and bearing are!

units.source_text: 亲王的事，毕竟太不成样子了！

en.t: The affair with the Prince is, after all, far too improper!

units.source_text: 将来如何解决呢？”

en.t: How is it to be settled in the future?"

units.source_text: 两人信口谈论。

en.t: The two of them talked idly and without restraint.

units.source_text: 右近本来独自一人操心，现在有了侍从，说起谎来也方便得多了。

en.t: Ukon had originally been worrying all by herself, but now that Jijū was there, it became much easier to keep up the deception.
